# owner: platform
import unittest
from rosterkit.notices import absence_notice
from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student
from datetime import date

PUPIL = Student("s1", "Lee", "Ana", "A")


class NoticeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_lists_sorted_absences(self):
        marks = [
            Mark("s1", date(2026, 3, 5), "absent"),
            Mark("s1", date(2026, 3, 4), "present"),
            Mark("s1", date(2026, 3, 2), "absent")
        ]
        text = absence_notice(PUPIL, marks)
        self.assertIn("Ana Lee", text)
        want = "2 day(s): 2026-03-02, 2026-03-05"
        self.assertIn(want, text)

    def test_other_student(self):
        marks = [Mark("s2", date(2026, 3, 2), "absent")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            absence_notice(PUPIL, marks)

    def test_no_absences(self):
        marks = [Mark("s1", date(2026, 3, 2), "late")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            absence_notice(PUPIL, marks)
